admission-forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
admission-not-entitled: The admission app is open to students of grades 10 and 11 and to admission staff.
admission-not-applicant: This part of the app is for students with a student account.
admission-guardian-consent-required: A parent or guardian must give consent first.
admission-char-limit: The text is longer than allowed.
admission-readiness-weights: Weights must be non-negative numbers for the known parts, and at least one above zero.
admission-quota-exceeded: You have reached the limit for now. Try again later.
admission-item-limit: You already have the maximum number of entries of this kind. Remove one to add another.
admission-item-incomplete: Fill in the required fields before marking this entry ready.
admission-projected-date-required: A planned number needs a target date.
admission-calendar-invalid: Check the dates: the range or the exam date is not valid.
admission-affordability-required: Fill in the affordability section first.
admission-invalid-proof-url: The link to the proof is not valid.
admission-invalid-media-url: The image link must be a valid https address.
admission-media-unreachable: The image could not be downloaded. Check the link or upload a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF up to 5 MB.
admission-test-score-invalid: This test entry is not valid. Check the scores, dates and required fields.
admission-invalid-transition: This step is not allowed in the current state.
admission-pickup-not-set: The pickup location has not been set yet.
admission-undo-expired: It is too late to undo this action.
admission-conflict: The data was changed by someone else. Reload and try again.
admission-scan-pending: The file is still being checked. Try again in a minute.
admission-delegation-denied: You cannot pass this permission on.
admission-invalid-answer: This answer is not valid. Check the question's rules and try again.
admission-voice-too-large: The recording is too large. Keep it under {max_mb} MB.
admission-voice-too-long: The recording is too long. Keep it under {max_seconds} seconds.
admission-voice-format: This recording format is not supported. Use one of: {formats}.
admission-safeguarding-support: What you wrote matters to us. If you or someone close to you is in danger, talk to a trusted adult, the school counsellor or a helpline (1050). You are not alone.
admission-saved-view-limit: You reached the saved views limit
admission-affordability-gate: {institution}: confirm that you can afford this option, or ask a counselor to sign it off, before choosing a binding round.
admission-proof-source: Add exactly one proof: a link, a file or pasted text.
admission-purpose-staff-view-text: Counselors and mentors assigned to me may see my profile, items and documents.
admission-purpose-ai-text: My essays and answers may be sent to an AI model for feedback, and my voice recordings to a speech model for transcription (the audio is not kept). Without it the app works without AI.
admission-purpose-sharing-text: I may share selected items with helpers and guests by link.
admission-purpose-finance-text: My budget and aid answers may be used to check affordability and seen by my counselor.
admission-catalog-fact-invalid: This fact is not valid. Check the value, the source link and the year.
admission-catalog-duplicate: This school is already in the catalog or has a pending proposal.
admission-catalog-in-use: This entry is used in student data, so it cannot be deleted. Hide it instead.
admission-catalog-proposal-limit: You have reached the daily limit of {limit} catalog proposals. Try again tomorrow.
admission-catalog-push-limit: You have reached the hourly limit of {limit} catalog push batches. Try again in an hour.
admission-fork-last-target: A supplemental essay needs at least one prompt. Keep this essay on its last prompt or change it instead.
admission-essay-too-short: The essay is too short to check. Write at least {min} words; it has {count} now.
admission-essay-vault-unavailable: Essays are locked for a moment because the key service is not answering. Your text is safe; try again in a few minutes.
admission-invite-not-found: This review link does not work. It may have expired or been switched off; ask the student for a new one.
admission-invite-limit: An essay can have at most {limit} active review links. Switch one off to add another.
admission-exemplar-invalid: This exemplar essay is not valid. Check the {field} field.
admission-exemplar-duplicate: This exemplar essay is already in the library.
admission-kb-body-invalid: The article body is not accepted. Use at most 3 OpenUI blocks of up to 6000 characters each, and only https, mailto or relative links.
admission-essay-key-unavailable: Your essays are temporarily unavailable. Try again later or contact support.
admission-essay-unreadable: This essay can no longer be opened: its encryption key has changed. You can delete it and start again.
admission-essay-keys-backup-taken: The key backup of this generation was already downloaded. Rotate the keys to make a new backup.
admission-essay-keys-backup-invalid: The backup file could not be opened. Check the file and the passphrase.
admission-essay-keys-rotation-running: A key rotation is running. Wait until it finishes and try again.
admission-catalog-cycle: The cycle must be the current or the next admission cycle, written as 2026-27 (cycle: {cycle}).
admission-scorecard-unavailable: College Scorecard is unavailable right now. Try again later.
plan-duplicate: This opportunity is already in your plan.
